parameters.name: AlertLevel
parameters.description:
The alert notification level. Valid values:

- 0: no alert

- 1: reminder

- 2: suspicious

- 3: high-risk.

parameters.name: ExcludeUsers
parameters.description: The list of users excluded from file protection.

parameters.name: FileOps
parameters.description: The list of operations performed on the file.

parameters.name: FilePaths
parameters.description: The list of monitored file paths. Wildcards are supported.

parameters.name: FileTypes
parameters.description: The list of protected file types.

parameters.name: ProcPaths
parameters.description: The list of process listening paths. Wildcards are supported.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action of the rule. Valid values:

- **block**: Block.

- **monitor**: Monitor.

- **pass**: Allow.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- **0**: disabled
- **1**: enabled.
